audit.why: Chart reads Skill / Irelia / Skill / Irelia / Ambessa / Skill / Irelia in both layers, matches the packet levelChart exactly, and matches the mirror audit's agreed shape (she owns level 6, you own the levels around it). Every why supports its own label.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike was described only as 'her ultimate plus chain CC' with no name and no number, and the full layer's ult tracking pointed at a fabricated ability.
audit.why: Public Execution is 130/115/100s, 1250 range, and it blinks to the farthest champion in a line, suppresses on arrival, then slams for damage and a stun. A 130-second rank-1 cooldown is the single biggest tempo lever in the lane.
audit.corrected: winCon, enemyWin, loading, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0] now name Public Execution and its 130s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet defect is exactly right: not one of Ambessa's six real ability names appeared anywhere in the full layer, which instead tracked an invented ability called 'Repeating Dashes'. Three real interactions were also absent — Repudiation's shield and its bracing bonus, Drakehound's Step as the burst tell, and Public Execution's suppression.
audit.why: Riot's text: Repudiation grants a shield and braces, dealing increased damage if she blocked non-minion damage while bracing — so hitting her mid-brace feeds it. Drakehound's Step dashes after any ability cast and grants the next attack bonus range and damage, making the wind-up the tell rather than the cast. Public Execution suppresses, which no dash escapes.
audit.corrected: 'Repeating Dashes' removed everywhere it was writable; Drakehound's Step, Repudiation and Public Execution written into tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, cooldowns, tradeGood, the do's and the don'ts. Defiant Dance stated as physical-specific against an all-physical kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] justified early Executioner's Calling with 'his healing fights your pattern' — wrong pronoun and no named source of the healing.
audit.why: The healing comes from Public Execution, which carries the heal flag.

notes: 'Repeating Dashes' was a fabricated ability name occupying the focus slot, the loading screen, the win condition, the cooldown block and every trade line. Her real dash mechanic is the passive Drakehound's Step; the ult to track is Public Execution. Some remaining occurrences sit in breakdown.mid, breakdown.spikes, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.difficulty, ahead, report[3], report[5], report[9], report[10], report[12] and report[13] — those strings are duplicated boilerplate and could not all be rewritten inside the length band in one pass; they are worth a champion-level find-and-replace of 'Repeating Dashes'. Also noting, as the mirror audit did, that the 'grounding' flag on Flawless Duet in the kit file contradicts Riot's own description (damaged, stunned and Marked — no grounding), so I did not use it here.
